newsitem.title: MEXICO: Fugitive Mexican embezzler is captured in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Fugitive Mexican embezzler is captured in Spain.

text.p: A Mexican fugitive convicted of embezzling from the Mexican subsidiary of the Eastman Kodak Co. was captured in Spain, Mexican authorities said on Sunday.
The Attorney General's Office said in a statement Mexico would begin extradition proceedings against Carlos Max Zapata Lozano, who was captured by Spanish police in Madrid on Friday.

Zapata was convicted last year in absentia and sentenced to five years and three months in prison for stealing at least $300,000 from Kodak Mexicana SA de CV. He was personnel manager of the company from July 1993 to August 1994.
The Attorney General's Office said Zapata had "altered accounts and made nonexistent operations and expenses appear in records."
He becomes the third Mexican fugitive to be held by Spain for extradition.

The others are former banker Angel Rodriguez, accused of defrauding Grupo Financiero Asemex-Banpais of more than $4 million, and Pablo Chapa Bezailla, a former prosecutor accused of falsifying evidence in a murder case against Raul Salinas de Gortari, brother of former president Carlos Salinas de Gortari.
Extradition proceedings against Rodriguez and Chapa are pending.
